def rotl8(x: int, k: int) -> int:
    """Rotate the 8-bit value x left by k bits, wrapping the high bits to the low end."""
    pre 0 <= x and x <= 255
    pre 0 <= k and k <= 7
    post out == ((x << k) | (x >> (8 - k))) & 255
    ex rotl8(129, 1) == 3
    ex rotl8(1, 7) == 128
    ex rotl8(200, 0) == 200
    return ((x << k) | (x >> (8 - k))) & 255
